claim: Some apps charge more on a Saturday, then cut back by Tuesday.
calculation: From data/findings_hours_weekend_penalty.csv (each Saturday rise and the cut that undid it): rises per Saturday over the last 4 Saturdays in the file, divided by rises per Saturday over every Saturday in the file. A rise counts only if its cut-back is also in the file.
window: the last 4 Saturdays, against every Saturday in the file
min_observations: at least 8 Saturdays and at least 10 rises in the file
invalid_if: the finding's last recheck in data/findings.json is more than 8 days old, or the minimum observations are not met
thresholds_text: holds: at least half the all-time rises per Saturday. weaker: between a tenth and a half. no longer true: under a tenth, or no rise in the last 4 Saturdays.
trigger: new hourly price rows (a new Saturday is judged once its Tuesday has passed)
proposed_by: Claude, 20 Oct 2026, from ROADMAP.md 'How a finding is tested'; the thresholds are proposals, merged by Seb's 20 Oct rule, and change only through a spec
